headline.text: Two holds active — *low-salt* Bequet on L1 S4 (8 pallets for rework), wrong case labels on L3 ML1. Metal debris found in L3 ML4 PTL2 filter during cleaning.

summary: Two quality holds in progress for rework/relabel. One foreign-material flag — metal debris found inside L3 ML4 PTL2 filter during changeover cleaning. L1 S4 torn belt trimmed but remained in service in product-contact zone. L1 S3 cleaning failure — chocolate found under belts after allergen clean was signed off.

holds.title: 8 pallets Bequet caramel — insufficient salt
holds.summary: Third-shift production on S4 yielded 7–8 pallets with very little or no salt on bottom of pieces; QA approved rework plan to blend with in-spec product at L3.
holds.status: Tagged QA Rework, scheduled for transfer to L3 for blending with compliant production.

holds.title: ML1 pallets — wrong case lot number
holds.summary: Third-shift case label left for first shift had incorrect lot number; first-shift pallet corrected, third-shift pallets on hold pending rework form.
holds.status: On hold pending rework documentation; first-shift pallet already corrected.

food_safety.title: S4 aligner belt torn, trimmed in service
food_safety.summary: Belt after Tunnel 2 found torn with potential to shed material onto product in direct contact zone; maintenance trimmed damaged area but residual loose material visible, line resumed after second trim and sanitation.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — belt trimmed twice, sanitized, monitored every 30 minutes; no further shedding observed by end of second shift.

food_safety.title: S4 possible Canada cellophane use
food_safety.summary: Second shift found 14.5 rolls of cellophane with barcodes (Canada-market indicator) on opened pallet; QA inspecting third-shift production to confirm if wrong packaging was applied.
food_safety.status: Investigation ongoing — QA inspecting all third-shift product; first shift also flagged to inspect TW before running.

food_safety.title: Metal debris in ML4 PTL2 filter
food_safety.summary: During first-shift ML4 clean, operator found foreign item (appears metallic) inside PTL2 filter; photo posted 08:51 MT.
food_safety.status: Open — filter was being cleaned as part of scheduled changeover; no indication item entered product stream.

quality.title: S1 Matrix 9 — wrong printer display on 3 pallets
quality.summary: Third-shift date change resulted in 3 pallets with case labels showing M5 instead of M9; printer output correct, matrix assignment incorrect.
quality.status: Resolved — Quality approved pallets for shipment after verification.

sanitation.title: S3 cleaning verification failure — chocolate under belts
sanitation.summary: During Matrix reassembly first shift unwrapped conveyors C-24 through C-26 and found chocolate under belts, on rollers, scrapers, and frames after allergen clean was signed off and wrapped; Matrix tops re-covered pending re-clean.
sanitation.status: Open — areas marked for re-cleaning; second-shift cleaning paperwork also missing multiple QA signatures.

opportunities.text: Review belt inspection and hold criteria for product-contact zones — S4 torn belt was trimmed and returned to service twice before stable; establish clear replacement threshold for equipment damage in direct-contact areas.
Review material scanning/traceability SOP — S4 wrong cellophane pallet and L3 truffle line un-scanned chocolate pallet both indicate gaps in scan-before-use enforcement.

Consider adding moving-equipment damage inspection to startup checklist — today's ingredient tank bump (cables damaged) and PTL2 filter debris both occurred during equipment repositioning after cleaning.
